name: 49000 ET - DAPI
summary: A widefield set for UV-excited blue dyes such as DAPI: UV excitation, a 400 nm long-pass dichroic and a blue emission band. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: 49001 ET - ECFP
summary: A set for cyan fluorescent protein, with violet-blue excitation and a cyan emission band kept clear of YFP. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: 49002 ET - EGFP (FITC/Cy2)
summary: The standard green set for GFP and fluorescein-type dyes: blue excitation, a 495 nm dichroic and a green emission band. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: 49003 ET - EYFP
summary: A set for yellow fluorescent protein, with narrow bands that help separate YFP from CFP and GFP. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: 49006 ET - Cy5
summary: A far-red set for Cy5 and similar dyes, with red excitation and near-infrared emission (best viewed with a camera). Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: 49008 ET - mCherry, Texas Red®
summary: A red set for mCherry and Texas Red: green-yellow excitation and a broad red emission band. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: 69002 ET - DAPI/FITC/Texas Red®
summary: A triple-band set with one multiband exciter, dichroic and emitter, so blue, green and red labels can be seen together without changing cubes. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: 89000 ET - Sedat Quad
summary: A Sedat set: one quad-band dichroic with single-band exciters and emitters in filter wheels, giving fast sequential four-colour imaging with low crosstalk. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp/bs dichroic).

name: DAPI-5060C-000
summary: A bright BrightLine set for DAPI and similar UV-excited blue dyes.

name: GFP-3035D-000
summary: A BrightLine single-band set for GFP and similar green dyes.

name: YFP-2427B-000
summary: A narrow-band BrightLine set for yellow fluorescent protein.

name: TxRed-4040C-000
summary: A BrightLine set for Texas Red and other red dyes.

name: mCherry-C-000
summary: A BrightLine set for mCherry with a wide red emission band.

name: Cy5-4040C-000
summary: A BrightLine set for Cy5 and other deep-red dyes.

name: DA/FI/TR/Cy5-4X-B-000
summary: A Pinkel set: four single-band exciters switched in a wheel, with a quad-band dichroic and quad-band emitter, so four colours are imaged by changing only the excitation.

name: LF405/488/561/635-A-000
summary: A full quad-band set for 405, 488, 561 and 635 nm lasers, with matched multiband exciter, dichroic and emitter.

name: BFP-A-000 (BrightLine 2.0)

specs.Fluorophores: BFP (EBFP), TagBFP, DAPI, Hoechst 33342, Alexa Fluor 350, Pacific Blue

summary: BrightLine 2.0 set for blue proteins and UV/violet-excited dyes; its fluorophore table rates DAPI and Hoechst as compatible, so it is the current blue/DAPI choice beside the older DAPI-5060C. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: LED-FITC-B-000 (BrightLine 2.0)
summary: BrightLine 2.0 green set matched to LED light engines, with a narrower blue excitation band than lamp-based sets. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: GFP-4050C-000 (BrightLine 2.0)

specs.Fluorophores: GFP (EGFP), Emerald, TurboGFP, Cy2, MitoTracker Green

summary: The BrightLine 2.0 GFP set, a redesign beside the older GFP-3035D with wider excitation and emission bands for brighter signal. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: Cy3-4040D-000 (BrightLine 2.0)

specs.Fluorophores: Cy3, Alexa Fluor 555, TRITC, DsRed, dTomato

summary: BrightLine 2.0 orange set for Cy3 and similar dyes, sharing its dichroic and emission filter with TRITC-C but using a wider excitation band. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: TRITC-C-000 (BrightLine 2.0)

specs.Fluorophores: TRITC, Alexa Fluor 546, Alexa Fluor 555, DsRed, mRFP

summary: BrightLine 2.0 set for TRITC and other orange-red dyes, with a narrow green excitation band. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: LED-TRITC-B-000 (BrightLine 2.0)
summary: BrightLine 2.0 orange-red set tuned for LED light engines. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: TxRed-4040D-000 (BrightLine 2.0)

specs.Fluorophores: Texas Red, mCherry, Alexa Fluor 568, Alexa Fluor 594, MitoTracker Red

summary: BrightLine 2.0 red set for Texas Red and mCherry, the newer design beside TxRed-4040C and mCherry-C. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: Cy5-4040D-000 (BrightLine 2.0)

specs.Fluorophores: Cy5, Alexa Fluor 647, APC, ATTO 647N, DiD

summary: BrightLine 2.0 far-red set, the newer design beside Cy5-4040C. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: LED-Cy5-B-000 (BrightLine 2.0)

specs.Fluorophores: Cy5, Alexa Fluor 647, ATTO 655, MitoTracker Deep Red

summary: BrightLine 2.0 far-red set for LED light engines, with a narrow red excitation band. The page gives a 41 nm bandwidth for the emitter whose part number reads 680/42. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: Cy7-B-000
summary: BrightLine near-infrared set for Cy7-class dyes. The IDEX page lists the three filters without naming exciter and emitter; roles here follow wavelength order (shorter band excites).

name: DA/FI/TR/Cy5-4X4M-C-000
summary: BrightLine Sedat set for four-colour imaging: one quad-band dichroic with four single-band exciters and four single-band emitters in filter wheels. The page lists all eight bandpass filters without roles; the split here pairs each band with the dichroic's reflection (excitation) and transmission (emission) bands.

name: LF405/488/561/635-B-000
summary: BrightLine full-multiband laser set with a flat (1 lambda P-V RWE) dichroic for super-resolution and TIRF with 405/488/561/635 nm lasers; newer than LF405/488/561/635-A. The page does not label exciter and emitter; roles follow the dichroic's reflection and transmission bands.

name: 49004 ET - CY3/TRITC
summary: Chroma's ET set for Cy3 and TRITC: green excitation, a 565 nm dichroic and a broad orange-red emission band. Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp dichroic).

name: 49007 ET - Cy7
summary: Chroma's near-infrared ET set for Cy7-class dyes (the page also recommends it for CL-750). Filter roles follow Chroma part suffixes (x exciter, m emitter, lp dichroic).

name: Fluorescence Filter Set for Green Fluorescence Protein (GFP)
summary: TECHSPEC hard-coated filter kit (stock #67-003) of excitation, emission and dichroic filters; the page gives passbands as wavelength ranges rather than centre/bandwidth.

name: Fluorescence Filter Set for Texas Red Fluorescence Dye
summary: TECHSPEC hard-coated filter kit (stock #67-008) of excitation, emission and dichroic filters; the page gives passbands as wavelength ranges rather than centre/bandwidth.

name: Fluorescence Filter Set for CY5 Fluorescence Dye
summary: TECHSPEC hard-coated filter kit (stock #67-010) of excitation, emission and dichroic filters; the page gives passbands as wavelength ranges rather than centre/bandwidth. Its excitation filter (#67-035) is the same part as the Texas Red set's emission filter.
